card.line: Dalmanutha was a town on the west side of the Sea of Galilee, near Magdala, where Jesus landed after feeding the four thousand and was tested by the Pharisees.

moments.title: Jesus comes by boat
moments.text: After sending the crowd away, Jesus got into the boat with His disciples. They went to the district of Dalmanutha.

moments.title: Pharisees demand a sign
moments.text: The Pharisees argued with Jesus and tested Him by asking for a sign from heaven. Jesus sighed deeply and said no sign would be given to this generation. Then He left them and crossed the lake again.
